# Quick filter absence is a state contract, not a false boolean convention

QuickFilterState.filterValues maps filter names to state values. setFilterValue deletes the named property for null or undefined, whereas false is retained as a value. persistToObj returns that dictionary, and defineFilter requires JSON-serializable states with undefined meaning no persisted state. Manual API and naming proposal for this family: distinguish an absent filter entry from a present value and keep the name-keyed dictionary contract in documentation and tests. Do not replace deletion with assignment of false as a style cleanup. Entry 699 changes the JSDoc dictionary notation; that formatter/lint-driven notation is not counted as a new manual rule.

Scope: quick-filter-state.
